itemEdital: Língua Inglesa — compreensão textual e gramática contextual
title: Compreensão textual e gramática contextual em inglês
objective: Treinar leitura orientada por evidência, referência pronominal, conectores e vocabulário em contexto sem depender de tradução palavra por palavra.

concepts.title: 1. Main idea
concepts.what: A main idea summarizes what the whole passage is doing, not one isolated sentence.
concepts.explanation: Read the opening, contrast markers and conclusion before choosing an option.
concepts.connection: Sua base de Inglês é mais forte, então a sessão prioriza nuance no estilo FGV.
concepts.trap: An option may repeat exact words and still describe a secondary detail.

immediate.prompt: If a paragraph lists benefits and then says 'however, these gains depend on data quality', the main idea is that
immediate.explanation: The contrast limits, not cancels, the benefits.

concepts.title: 2. Reference words
concepts.what: Pronouns and demonstratives point back to a semantically compatible antecedent.
concepts.explanation: For 'this approach', look for the preceding idea or method, not merely the nearest noun.
concepts.connection: FGV frequentemente usa textos-base comuns para várias questões de Inglês.
concepts.trap: The nearest noun is not always the semantic antecedent.

immediate.prompt: In 'The team changed the pipeline. This reduced latency', 'This' refers mainly to
immediate.explanation: The demonstrative resumes the preceding action/idea.

concepts.title: 3. Connectors
concepts.what: However signals contrast; therefore result; although concession; whereas contrast; unless negative condition.
concepts.explanation: Connector meaning can determine the logical relation even when some vocabulary is unknown.
concepts.connection: Útil tanto em leitura quanto em gramática contextual.
concepts.trap: Do not translate connectors loosely; identify their logical job.

concepts.title: 4. Vocabulary from context
concepts.what: Infer meaning by function, surrounding words and contrast rather than isolated memory.
concepts.explanation: If a sentence says 'the method is robust: it remains stable under noise', the colon helps explain robust.
concepts.connection: Reduz dependência de conhecer cada palavra do texto.
concepts.trap: False cognates and familiar-looking words are common distractors.

immediate.prompt: In 'The improvement was negligible, barely changing the final score', negligible most likely means
immediate.explanation: The restatement 'barely changing' provides the clue.

finalQuestions.prompt: Read: 'Automation can speed up routine work. However, poorly defined rules may reproduce mistakes faster.' The passage mainly argues that
options: speed alone does not guarantee quality
finalQuestions.explanation: 'However' introduces the limitation: speed without sound rules may amplify errors.

finalQuestions.prompt: In 'The model was retrained with newer data. This improved its performance', 'This' refers to
options: the model as a noun only
finalQuestions.explanation: The demonstrative resumes the preceding event.

finalQuestions.prompt: Choose the best meaning of 'whereas' in: 'Training accuracy increased, whereas validation accuracy fell.'
In 'The improvement was marginal—less than one percentage point', marginal means
finalQuestions.explanation: The explanation after the dash defines the magnitude as small.

finalQuestions.prompt: Which strategy is most reliable when an unfamiliar word appears?
options: Use syntactic role, nearby explanations and contrast clues.
Assume it is a Portuguese cognate.
finalQuestions.explanation: Contextual evidence is the core reading strategy.
finalQuestions.real_question_reference: FGV — DATAPREV 2024 — bloco real de Língua Inglesa das provas ATI, Q13–24: um texto-base comum é usado em várias questões; consulte o caderno original para observar o formato.
